name: LINE
description: LINE is a messaging and social platform whose LINE Login v2.1 product provides OAuth and OpenID Connect identity for users of customer applications.
agentUseSummary: Connect one user through Relay's confidential LINE Login channel with mandatory S256 PKCE and exact profile/openid scopes. Relay exposes one fixed read of the OIDC-bound user's main profile; email, friendship state, Messaging API channel tokens, bot authority, messages, webhooks, audiences, exports, arbitrary API access, and every write remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: LINE_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: LINE Login channel ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held production LINE Login Channel ID.

credentialRequirements.name: LINE_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: LINE Login channel secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-encrypted Channel Secret; never returned to clients or agents.

capabilities.label: Read connected profile
capabilities.description: Read the bound LINE Login user's useful main-profile fields.

allowed.label: Read connected profile
allowed.description: Return userId, displayName, and optional pictureUrl/statusMessage for the OIDC-bound LINE Login user.

blocked.label: Access extra identity
blocked.description: Email, phone, friendship status, social graph, add-friend prompts, subprofiles, and broader personal data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use Messaging API authority
blocked.description: Channel access tokens, Official Account administration, bot profiles, webhooks, messages, replies, push, multicast, narrowcast, broadcast, rich menus, and audiences are outside V1.

blocked.label: Write or use raw LINE access
blocked.description: All writes, exports, arbitrary endpoints, retries, pagination, and raw provider tools are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Only the OIDC-bound main-profile read is enabled.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one fixed LINE Login profile wrapper and attaches refreshed user access server-side.
Railway mounts one fixed LINE Login profile wrapper and attaches refreshed user access server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's production LINE Login channel, exact Railway callback, profile/openid approval, brand/publication review, and real connected-user lifecycle evidence are not available.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create and approve the production LINE Login channel, register the exact Railway callback, configure LINE_CLIENT_ID and LINE_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then deploy and run consent, subject/profile binding, refresh, profile read, revoke, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: LINE documents active Login v2.1 OAuth/OIDC and main-profile fields including user ID, display name, image URL, and status message.
LINE documents PKCE for Authorization Code and supports only S256.
LINE documents token issue/refresh/revoke, ID-token verification, and GET /v2/profile with profile scope.
LINE documents Messaging API channel access tokens as a separate high-authority channel credential excluded from the Login profile connector.
